config.initialization: L1 architecture only, same seed13 random parameters, no task/external checkpoint loaded. Center gain sqrt(7) is fixed analytic variance matching, not an old-data fit. Train-only normalization fitted separately for O0 and B78; A21 shares O0 Train exactly.
config.training: Two full-model trajectories: O0 and B78, each80 epochs and90 steps/epoch. A21 has identical Train to O0 and selects a separate checkpoint on A21 Val; it does not need a duplicate training run. Entire encoder, DEMON and modified public TabM train. Same from-scratch learning rates and budget.
config.selection: Epoch0 reference only. Epoch1+ prefer Val -10ACC>=55 and original background>=84.507%; then original mean(Single,Double,ACC), original background, mean noisy ACC. All three checkpoints sealed before Test.
config.prediction: Same L1 seven-set plus count residual, mean32 member softmax then argmax. No true count or source recordings at inference.
config.fallback: Development comparison: retain all results. If B78 -10 Test ACC<55, background<95 or original ACC more than3pp below A21, prefer A21 when it meets the protection; if neither new protocol is suitable, preserve original dataset. No original files overwritten.
